column1: # Connected direct-unary source evidence consolidated from all three predecessor owners.

column5: The bounded cache authority preserves key construction, disabling, admission, retained exact-key validation, Get and Set, response fields 7/8/9, hit restoration, miss insertion, and absent versus present-empty paging ranges. The direct-unary runtime invokes the predicate and accepted-response lifecycle around real TiKV RPCs; Ristretto sampled-LFU, asynchronous visibility, aliasing, eviction metrics, and non-finite conversion parity remain open.

EMA math and concurrency connect to classic and next-generation response-byte extraction plus successful-page observation; the coordinator and all CopPagingState continuations share one Arc<ReadBytesEma> rather than copying independent estimators. Non-finite and out-of-range Go float-to-uint64 conversion remains open.
Complete first-middle-last representation, slicing, splitting, traversal, reset, formatting, safe protobuf conversion, and live retry/remain consumption execute without Go unsafe aliases.

A loader-backed RegionCache is the sole direct-unary topology authority. It walks half-open ranges with exact successor boundaries and forward progress, rejects malformed loader output before insertion, deduplicates overlapping inputs, reuses cached snapshots, validates delayed observations, updates known leaders, accepts available epoch-mismatch sibling subsets atomically, and invalidates exact versions. The integrated PD loader filters removed stores and witnesses while preserving unknown role discriminants; TTL, buckets, background liveness refresh, lock resolution, panic diagnostics, and production concurrency remain open.

Exact TiKV/TiFlash/TiDB/TiFlashCompute endpoint discriminants and the disaggregated TiFlash mapping execute as pure request metadata. The KV layer owns immutable requests, structured address-generation failure, exact-generation close, foreground gRPC health, and shared canonical store failure state without depending upward on DistSQL. Multi-connection pool policy, background recovery, TLS, replica seeds beyond voters, and broad Close coordination remain open.

The read path owns source-shaped per-region retry categories including TiKVRPC transport failure, capped exponential/equal-jitter arithmetic, ServerBusy sleep exclusion, longest effective exhaustion identity, one shared sender/outer budget, and injected cancellation-aware sleeping. The full generic Backoffer, context variables, metrics, TxnLockFast caps, and lock-resolution budgets remain open.

All seven TiDB replica-read discriminants map exactly to client-go, including both closest modes becoming mixed and unknown values returning leader zero. The live path admits only the PD-declared TiKV leader and fails every other replica policy closed; follower/stale/prefer-leader routing, labels, seed rotation, proxying, and generic fallback remain open.

Driver defaults are cloned before exact replacement options, PD dial-option metadata preserves max receive size, keepalives, timeout, forwarding, and metrics labels, and SourceStmt trace injection is a nil no-op that preserves unrelated fields. Plaintext PD discovery and address-keyed TiKV gRPC execute in the bounded read path. Global hooks/config mutation, path parsing, TLS/keyspace setup, broad store lifecycle, safe point, latches, generic RPC pooling/retry, active cancellation, and Close remain open.

SelectWithRuntimeStats prepares checked logical tasks from shared RegionCache topology and returns one lazy QueryResponse. Immediately before each send, the response selects against current canonical store state; connection failure performs exact close/liveness/store invalidation/backoff/reselection and preserves logical order, paging, cache, EMA, and response accounting. QueryResultContext and QuerySelectResult retain warning, raw subset, runtime metadata, and close ownership. Analyze, Checksum, follower/stale reads, TiFlash, active RPC cancellation, memory accounting, asynchronous production, and full runtime-stat formatting remain fail-closed or external.

The existing lack_handles leaf remains executable after ownership consolidation, and the IndexReader post-lowering lifecycle consumes already-built requests through the canonical lazy query runtime: Open transfers every response once, ordered Next forwards its remaining caller row budget through serial/select/query response owners, and explicit or RAII Close releases every opened response exactly once. The post-lowering reader can reach the concrete unary client in focused tests; physical-plan/DAG/range construction, KV handle encoding, lookup workers, consistency reporting, sorted merging, response-close errors, and real table-reader-driven TiKV queries remain open.
